In MSK Serverless, MSK manages the broker nodes and you provision your Kafka server resources only at the cluster level.

qualifiers.scope: per Availability Zone, MSK cluster for which you specify broker nodes

evidence.quote: **Broker nodes** — When creating an Amazon MSK cluster, you specify how many broker nodes you want Amazon MSK to create in each [Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-infrastructure/latest/regions/aws-availability-zones.html). The minimum is one broker per Availability Zone.
In [MSK Serverless](serverless.md), MSK manages the broker nodes used to handle your traffic and you only provision your Kafka server resources at a cluster level.
